say:1:1821625001:0.text: These stowaways aren't my patients. Why are you forcing me to stay?
say:1:1821625001:0.source_cn: 这些偷渡者又不是我的责任，为什么非要强迫我留在这里？

say:2:1821625002:0.text: They booked passage with Deadreef Shipping, and Deadreef Shipping belongs to the Syndicate. That makes them your customers too—and your responsibility!
say:2:1821625002:0.source_cn: 我们是暗礁航运的客户，暗礁航运的客户就相当于黑金商会的...

say:3:1821625003:0.text: Besides, they're getting worse by the minute!
say:3:1821625003:0.source_cn: 更何况……他们的情况越来越差了！

say:4:1821625004:0.text: For the last time—not my problem!

say:5:1821625005:1.source_cn: 你——！你果然是个没有同情心的亡灵！

say:8:1821625006:0.text: Thank Dura, you're back! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please talk some sense into them!
say:8:1821625006:0.male: Thank Dura, you're back! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please talk some sense into them!
say:8:1821625006:0.female: Thank Dura, you're back! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please talk some sense into them!

say:9:1821625007:0.text: If this keeps up, they'll tear the whole Repair House apart!
say:9:1821625007:0.source_cn: 再吵下去，我真怕她们把修缮屋砸了！
say:9:1821625007:0.male: If this keeps up, they'll tear the whole Repair House apart!
say:9:1821625007:0.female: If this keeps up, they'll tear the whole Repair House apart!

narration:10:1821625008:1.text: Morrie looks at you as though you're his last hope. Reluctantly, you step between the two women.
narration:10:1821625008:1.male: Morrie looks at you as though you're his last hope. Reluctantly, you step between the two women.
narration:10:1821625008:1.female: Morrie looks at you as though you're his last hope. Reluctantly, you step between the two women.

narration:11:1821625009:1.text: As you calm them down, you explain Tephesia's proposal to remove the stowaways' disguises early.
narration:11:1821625009:1.male: As you calm them down, you explain Tephesia's proposal to remove the stowaways' disguises early.
narration:11:1821625009:1.female: As you calm them down, you explain Tephesia's proposal to remove the stowaways' disguises early.

say:13:1821625010:0.text: Remove their disguises now? Yes, that would relieve some of the symptoms. However—
say:13:1821625010:0.source_cn: 现在就解除偷渡者的伪装魔法？这倒的确能缓解一部分症状。...
say:13:1821625010:0.male: Remove their disguises now? Yes, that would relieve some of the symptoms. However—
say:13:1821625010:0.female: Remove their disguises now? Yes, that would relieve some of the symptoms. However—

say:14:1821625011:1.text: No! Absolutely not! Without those disguises, everyone will know they're living!
say:14:1821625011:1.source_cn: ——不行，绝对不行！没了伪装魔法，他们会暴露生者的身份的！
say:14:1821625011:1.male: No! Absolutely not! Without those disguises, everyone will know they're living!
say:14:1821625011:1.female: No! Absolutely not! Without those disguises, everyone will know they're living!

say:15:1821625012:0.text: If the guards find out, both the Syndicate and Bantus will have my head!
say:15:1821625012:0.source_cn: 要是被守卫发现，商会和班题斯肯定都不会饶过我的！
say:15:1821625012:0.male: If the guards find out, both the Syndicate and Bantus will have my head!
say:15:1821625012:0.female: If the guards find out, both the Syndicate and Bantus will have my head!

say:17:1821625013:0.text: A reminder, sir—this is Novaris. Lady Tephesia governs here, not Bantus.
say:17:1821625013:0.source_cn: 这位先生，请容许我提醒你，这里是诺珐斯，由领主阁下自治...

say:18:1821625014:0.text: Lady Tephesia has personally approved <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s plan. Keep the patients inside and under your care, and no one will trouble you.
say:18:1821625014:0.male: Lady Tephesia has personally approved <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s plan. Keep the patients inside and under your care, and no one will trouble you.
say:18:1821625014:0.female: Lady Tephesia has personally approved <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s plan. Keep the patients inside and under your care, and no one will trouble you.

say:19:1821625015:0.text: One more thing—neither of you will speak of this. Not even within the Syndicate.
say:19:1821625015:0.source_cn: 另外，还请两位闭紧嘴巴，不要泄露此事，哪怕是在商会内部。

say:20:1821625016:1.text: Rest assured. My lips are sealed.

say:21:1821625017:1.text: Well, if Lady Tephesia has approved it, I see no problem with <style="stress"><player_name></style> lifting the disguises. And if anyone complains, at least they can't pin it on me.

say:26:1821625020:1.source_cn: 哼，黑金商会的破规定有什么好遵守的！

say:27:1821625021:1.text: Enough. You two tend to the patients. <style="stress"><player_name></style> will prepare the potion, and neither of you will interfere.

say:28:1821625022:1.text: And I'll be watching both of you! No running off, and no funny business!
say:28:1821625022:1.source_cn: 而我——负责盯着你们！不要试图逃跑，更别想使坏！

say:30:1821625024:1.text: Ugh... How did I get dragged into this mess?
